en: That has to be the biggest $n I have ever seen... and it's coming right for us!
Remove your disguise, lest you feel the bite of my blade when the fury has taken control.
Hail, $c. You look familiar... have we met before?$B$BWell if we have met, then... surely you were given a secret code. Tell me your code and I will give you a gift!
If a bank is what you desire, then your travels take you to the heart of Darnassus.  There you will find storage for your treasures.
Here they come! Defend yourselves!
You must save us!
Who dares summon the power of the void?
I have just the spell to get this door open. Too bad the cell doors weren't locked so haphazardly.
I can't even visit my father's grave in peace anymore.
<Wake Tarsis up.>
Light be with you, sir.
This one is slightly better than the last. However, it still suffers from the same flimsy bone structure as the others. When you summon one of these, you are on the right path.
We serve Thrall with great pride.  We'll travel as far as is needed to vanquish the enemy.
We shall earn our deaths at the very least!
Look, there! By Hive'Regal! Is that... a sandworm?!
If you seek to become my student, you'll need to complete an assignment for me. Prove yourself worthy, and I might even consider rewarding you.
Death is merely a doorway to rebirth. The brood shall rise again.
The Loch belongs to the Stonesplinter Tribe now, $n!  Now die!
Elder Bladeswift wanders the paths of Darnassus atop Teldrassil.
Ever since the shadows claimed Duskwood I haven't been able to sleep. I am kept awake by the ghostly sounds of screaming on the breeze. It sounds almost like lambs screaming, and they won't stop.
Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.
Hmm, you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. If you do what I ask, and do it well, maybe we can discuss your training.

While Greta focuses her energy on the recovery of Jaedenar and those who she thinks is mostly responsible for the corruption here in Felwood. I spend my time looking into the effects the corruption has had on the land.$B$BHow has it affected the creatures of the land? What must be done to end the pain of their suffering?$B$BUnfortunately, the corruption runs so deep that eternal sleep is too often the answer.
Thank you, $n.  And luck to you.
Though I move on in peace, you all have my undying gratitude. Thank you for freeing me from the curse of my folly and greed.
Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit the tauren Krulmoo Fullmoon in Camp Taurajo of the Barrens. He has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.
Razorfen Downs can be found on the very southern tip of the Barrens on the east side of the road.
Go find Zando'zan in the Cleft of Shadow.  There are a couple of tunnels leading down into that cavern, one just south of the Valley of Wisdom and the other in The Drag.
My job title is Waste Management Specialist.
I am here!  Your rule of this land is over!
Ahhh... Ironfoe.
Father Cobb will be the one you want to talk to. He can be found under the Spirit Rise in the Pools of Vision cave.
Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

Come one, come all.  Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire!  Don't be shy.  Step right up to Lhara and buy yourself an exotic artifact from far off lands.  If you're one of the lucky few who have found Darkmoon Cards, have a word with Professor Paleo.  Hungry?  Thirsty?  You're in luck!  Refreshments are available right here from Sylannia and Stamp.  I recommend the Darkmoon Special Reserve to wash down some Red Hot Wings.  And if the future is what you seek, then run, don't walk, to speak with Sayge.
Sergeant Hartman!  I need to buy another stink bomb cleaner!
Look for Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.  Find it in the middle of The Drag, west of the huge tree.
